utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah — I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly just a quick headcount and any folks you can point me to who want to help—I can coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—thank you. I’ll keep it low-key and fit the repair drive around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, that sounds workable. Do you want me to help gather the missing items list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please — that would be a big help. If you can send me the missing items list, I’ll fit everything around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — that’s all set for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Opal. I’ll bring my tools by and we can double-check everything before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ve got the community center entrance at 10:00 noted. I’ll be there to double-check everything with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’m happy to help once I know the exact timing and drop-off spot. I’m just trying to make sure the parking and logistics won’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — once we lock down the timing and drop-off spot, I’ll update the supply list too. Just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I will. I just want to make sure I know where to go and when so I can plan for the parking.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, the repair drive is this Saturday—everyone’s pitching in, and you’re absolutely welcome to join us. I can send you the details right now!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plans to the neighbors and make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you spreading the word. I’ll send the details now so everyone has the right info.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d help a heap, Rey. If you can jot down the tasks and names, I’ll try to keep my head on straight for once.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep a little list of the tasks and names, and pass along whatever I hear. I’m already hearing folks lean toward practical supplies, so I’ll bring you a clearer rundown soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Much obliged, Tess. I’ll wait for your rundown and try not to wander off with the wrong supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by and drop off a few things by the garage on my way back. Glad the repair drive is coming together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. Just leave them by the garage, and I’ll make sure everything gets sorted for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll leave them by the garage on my way back. Glad it’s all coming together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 10:00 by the community center entrance with my gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Eli — thank you. I’ll bring the latest details to the community center entrance at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara — I’ll see you there at 10:00 by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you send me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive is for? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll send over the date, time, and a quick note on the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep an eye out for those details and make sure I’ve got them right.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still sure the repair drive is the right one, Bo? I’d want to double-check it before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m pretty sure it’s the right one—I just need to recheck the list before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but I want to double-check the list first before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good — thank you. Keep it low-key, and please start with the back gate first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll keep it low-key and start with the back gate first. I’ll swing by late and check in if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. That helps a lot — just the back gate first, and I’ll keep things quiet here.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — I’m getting everything organized and can share the signup sheet and needs list as soon as you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the drop-off spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — that helps a lot. Just send me the drop-off spot and timing when you’ve got them, and I’ll keep everything updated.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ve got us set for 10:00 at the community center entrance. Bring work gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll bring gloves and a flashlight, and I’ll help spread the word. See you at 10:00 at the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate it. See you at 10:00 by the community center entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late too, but I can stop by and check the signup sheet. If you need anything, I can bring tape and a marker.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Dane — tape and a marker would help. I’ll check my garage too and see if I can find a screwdriver and some screws.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by and leave a few things by the garage on my way back. Glad to hear the repair drive is coming together!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — could you let me know the exact drop-off spot and timing first? I’m happy to help once I know where everything’s going.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll leave them right by the garage this afternoon on my way back. I’ll text you if I’m running early or late.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you help coordinate who’s bringing which tools and supplies for the repair drive? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll help coordinate the tools and supplies and spread the word. I’ll send out the details and see who can bring what.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. Let me know if you need anything from me to help get the details out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, lovely — I’ll keep passing along the practical needs as I hear them, and between the two of us folks should stay well informed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — that’d help a lot. Keep me posted on the practical needs, and I’ll bring my tools by when you’re ready to double-check.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear what practical things they still need most.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, I’ve got a few basics for the repair drive, but I need to check the list again. I’ll get back to you with what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive details to the neighbors and let everyone know what to bring once you send the updated list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll skim the list and send you what’s still missing soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The back gate still needs the first look, then the loose step by the porch after that. I can help, just need to keep it low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds right to me — low-key is good. I’ll keep track of the list and make sure we start with the back gate, then the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate you keeping it simple today.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you bring a quick list of any missing supplies, and if you have them, some tape and a few basic tools?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll bring a quick missing-supplies list, plus tape and a few basic tools if I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the latest details too, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the drop-off spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — that helps. I’ll keep my list ready, and we can fill in the details once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I’ll check on the drop-off spot and timing, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. Thanks for keeping your list ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the list — could you send me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive is for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — it’s at 10:00 by the community center entrance, and I’ll bring work gloves and a small flashlight. I’m not sure which repairs are on the list yet, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I’ve got the time and location. If you can send the repair list details when you have them, I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still gathering the details, but I’ll fill you in as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm it’s still the repair drive and not something else? I just want to double-check before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still the repair drive, not something else. I’m just confirming the last few details, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’m getting everything organized, and I’ll share the signup and supply list so it’s easy to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds great, Rosa—send it over when you can and I’ll keep track of the missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the signup and supply list over shortly, and we can fill in any gaps together.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
